description:
REQUIRES: opi-fin.6.2, opi-fin.6.3, opi-fin.5.4 (Tools stateful migration) merged.

FILES:
- extensions/tools.ex + test (already stateful-migrated in opi-fin.5.4)
- test/support/harness.ex + harness_test.exs

TOOLS EXTENSION:
Replace get_all_tools, get_active_tools, set_active_tools, append_entry fn-field calls with Host client calls. These are called inside handlers where ctx is available. Remove remaining bind_core usage from tools.ex and tools_test.exs.

HARNESS:
harness.ex currently builds before_tool_call and after_tool_call closures that call Dispatcher functions directly, and wires action mocks via bind_core. Update Harness.create/1 to:
1. Start a Host.Stub GenServer with the test session's tool/command config.
2. Pass host: host_pid when creating Context for dispatch.
3. Remove bind_core-based action mocking.
Expose the Host.Stub pid from Harness.create/1 so integration tests can assert on Host.Stub.calls/1.

TEST: Update harness_test.exs. All existing behavioral assertions must pass. Add an assertion that verifies actions dispatched during a session are recorded on Host.Stub.
title: 6b: Migrate tools extension and update Harness
